prompt: A cinematic, photorealistic wide shot of a bustling Tokyo street at dusk. The central subject is a massive, bipedal police robot standing approximately three stories tall. The robot features an industrial design with heavy-duty black mechanical joints and white armored plating. It has a rectangular head unit equipped with multiple camera lenses and red emergency lights on its shoulders. The text "警視庁 MPD" is clearly printed in white on the robot's chest plate and shoulder guards. In the foreground, a drunk Japanese salaryman in a dark suit and loosened tie is stumbling backward while holding a beer can in one hand and taking a selfie with his smartphone in the other. To the right, two human police officers wearing dark uniforms with "警視庁 MPD" on their backs stand near a metal guardrail, looking up at the machine. The background includes warm yellow streetlights, blurred pedestrians, a blue road sign pointing to Nihonbashi, and the illuminated Tokyo Tower rising against a purple and orange twilight sky.

promptZh: 一幅电影感十足的超写实广角镜头，描绘了黄昏时分熙熙攘攘的东京街头。画面主体是一台约三层楼高的巨型双足警用机器人。机器人采用工业设计风格，配备重型黑色机械关节与白色装甲板。它的头部呈长方体，装有多个摄像头镜头，双肩还配有红色警示灯。胸甲和肩甲上清晰印有白色的“警視庁 MPD”字样。前景中，一名身穿深色西装、领带松垮的日本醉酒上班族正踉跄后退，一手拿着啤酒罐，另一手举着智能手机自拍。画面右侧，两名身穿深色制服、背后印有“警視庁 MPD”的人类警察站在金属护栏旁，抬头仰望着这台机器。背景里可见暖黄色的路灯、虚化的行人、指向日本桥的蓝色路牌，以及在紫橙交织的暮色天空中熠熠生辉的东京塔。
